abstract: BACKGROUND: To investigate the spectrum of CT and MRI findings of dysgerminoma of the ovary. METHODS: CT and MRI imaging of 12 patients with 13 histologically proven dysgerminomas of the ovary were retrospectively reviewed. Patients(,) ages ranged from 6 ~ 27 years (mean, 17.2 years). Two observers evaluated the following CT and MRI features of the tumor by consensus: (i) location, shape, and size; (ii) attenuation, T2 signal intensity, and ADC value; (iii) patterns of contrast enhancement; (iv) presence of fibrovascular septa; (v) presence of necrosis, hemorrhage, and calcification; (vi) presence of "ovarian vascular pedicle" sign. We also noted the extent or stage of the tumors. RESULTS: 75% lesions arised in the right ovary. Bilateral ovaries were involved in one case. Tumors displayed as a purely or predominantly solid mass (mean size, 17.0 ± 7.8 cm). Ten tumors were shaped multilobulated. The mean ADC value of lesions was 0.830 ± 0.154 × 10(- 3) mm(2)/s. Characteristic fibrovascular septa were observed in all lesions. Among them, classic septa were present in 69% lesions. They were thin, hypointense on T2WI with a linear intense enhancement indicating the blood vessels in septa. Due to the stromal edema, fibrovascular septa may become thick even amorphous in shape, hyperintense on T2WI and even low attenuation on CT with a slight enhancement except for a bright blood vessel on the edge. Massive necrosis was observed only in one lesion. Calcification was present in 3 of the 5 tumors on CT. "Ovarian vascular pedicle" sign was present in 12 lesions. Lymphadenopathy, retroperitoneal spread, and distant metastases combined with an implantation in Douglas' cul-de-sac were present in one patient respectively. CONCLUSION: On CT and MR images, ovarian dysgerminoma often appears as a large solid mass. The edematous condition of characteristic fibrovascular septa can be well displayed by imaging which then can guide the radiologists to make an accurate diagnosis. Calcifications often occur in the tumor. Nonspecific low ADC value and "ovarian vascular pedicle" sign may narrow the differential diagnosis.
abstract_ja: 背景：卵巣ディスジャーミノーマのCTおよびMRI所見の幅を明らかにすること。方法：組織学的に確定した卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ13例（12名の患者）のCTおよびMRI画像を後方視的に検討した。患者の年齢は6〜27歳（平均17.2歳）であった。2名の観察者が、以下のCTおよびMRIの所見について合議により評価した：（i）部位、形状、大きさ、（ii）CT減弱値、T2信号強度、ADC値、（iii）造影パターン、（iv）線維血管性隔壁の有無、（v）壊死、出血、石灰化の有無、（vi）「卵巣血管茎」徴候の有無。また腫瘍の進展範囲または病期も記録した。結果：75%の病変は右卵巣に生じた。片側例は両側卵巣の関与を1例で認めた。腫瘍は完全または主に充実性の腫瘤として描出された（平均サイズ17.0 ± 7.8 cm）。10例の腫瘍は多葉状の形態を示した。病変のADC値の平均は0.830 ± 0.154 × 10(-3) mm²/sであった。特徴的な線維血管性隔壁は、すべての病変で認められた。そのうち、典型的な隔壁は69%の病変で認められた。これらは細く、T2強調像で低信号を示し、隔壁内の血管を示す線状の強い造影効果を認めた。間質浮腫により、線維血管性隔壁は肥厚し、無定形になることがあり、T2強調像で高信号、CTでは低減弱値を示し、辺縁の明瞭な血管を除けば軽度に造影された。壊死が顕著であったのは1病変のみであった。石灰化はCTで5例中3例に認められた。「卵巣血管茎」徴候は12病変で認められた。リンパ節腫大、後腹膜進展、遠隔転移、ダグラス窩への播種を伴う例がそれぞれ1名に認められた。結論：CTおよびMRIでは、卵巣ディスジャーミノーマはしばしば大きな充実性腫瘤として描出される。特徴的な線維血管性隔壁の浮腫性変化は画像で明瞭に描出でき、正確な診断に導く。石灰化は腫瘍内にしばしば認められる。非特異的な低ADC値と「卵巣血管茎」徴候は、鑑別診断を絞り込むのに役立つ可能性がある。
